title: fix(plugin-detail): a logged call, meeting or email shows in the record feed under showCompleted's default (objectui#12228)
body:
Fixes #12228

Clause-②: no

## What changes

The record feed's `showCompleted` filter (`applyFeedConfig` in `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordActivityFeed.ts`) no longer hides a logged call, meeting or email. Before, the mapper sent every `completed` `sys_activity` row to a `task` item, and `showCompleted` (spec default `false`) dropped every `task` item. A logged interaction is written as `type: 'completed'`, so the synthesized default record page, whose `record:discussion` carries no `feed`, never showed one.

Now the filter keeps a `task` item that carries the ADR-0052 source pointer (`sourceObject` with a `sourceId`, read by the new `isLoggedInteraction`). That is the same reading `RecordActivityTimeline` uses for its View source link, so the items it exempts are exactly the items the timeline already links to their source record. One rule in the filter; `record-activity.tsx` and `record-chatter.tsx` both call it, and the console page's merged feed builds its items with the same `activityRowToFeedItem`, so all three surfaces change together.

As triage `6123741436` ruled: the synthesizer is unchanged (no `showCompleted` prop added), `showCompleted`'s default stays `false`, and `showCompleted` now governs finished tasks only.

## Which field marks a logged interaction (read before writing)

- The three producers are HotCRM actions, read at objectstack-ai/hotcrm `0f84c9c`: `log_call` / `log_meeting` (its activity-action factory, `src/sales/actions/activity-actions.ts`) and `send_email` (`src/sales/actions/contact.actions.ts`). Each writes the rich record first (a `crm_event`, or a `sys_email` row), then one `sys_activity` row with `type: 'completed'`, `source_object` / `source_id` naming that record, and `metadata` JSON with `kind` set to `call`, `meeting` or `email`. The factory's own header calls that row "the unified-timeline pointer".
- `sys_activity` has no channel or sub-type column and no task-only field (objectstack plugin-audit's `sys-activity.object.ts`). The pointer pair is declared there ("Object name of the rich source entity this activity was derived from ... Null when the activity is about the target record itself") and on `FeedItem` (`sourceObject` / `sourceId`, `@object-ui/types`). The read-side redaction (`activity-field-redaction.ts`) does not touch it.
- The platform's own CRUD mirror (`audit-writers.ts`) never sets the pointer, and the only `completed` rows it writes are milestones, which objectui#12106 already moves to `system`. So a `completed` row without a pointer (a finished task, or a milestone row from a runtime before the marker) stays hidden by default.

Two alternatives were measured and not taken:

- `metadata.kind`: ADR-0052 keeps `type` domain-neutral and puts one vertical's words in `metadata.kind`, an open vocabulary. Recognising logged interactions by kind would be a list of HotCRM's words in the renderer, and `metadata` does not survive onto `FeedItem`, so a host feed could not be judged by it.
- A different feed type (the objectui#12106 milestone shape): authored pages list these rows AS tasks. HotCRM's lead page `record:activity` sets `types: ['task']` with `showCompleted: true` to show its calls, and `filterMode: 'tasks_only'` selects them. Moving them off `task` would empty that tab, which is the opposite of the pin "an authored page with `showCompleted: true` is unchanged".

## Pins

New file `recordActivityFeed.loggedInteraction-12228.test.tsx`, 17 tests, fixtures in the producers' shapes:

- a logged call, meeting and email show under `showCompleted`'s default, on `record:discussion` and `record:activity`;
- a finished task (a `completed` row with no pointer) stays hidden while `showCompleted` is false or absent; KEEP-LEG: `showCompleted: true` shows it;
- an authored page with `showCompleted: true` is unchanged: HotCRM's lead shape (`types: ['task']`) and case shape list every completed row, all still `task`;
- the mapper is unchanged (each logged row maps to `task` and carries its pointer); `types: ['task']` selects them and `types: ['comment']` does not; `unifiedTimeline: false` keeps them;
- five CONTROL shapes stay hidden by default: only the call's `metadata.kind` with no pointer, `source_object` without `source_id`, `source_id` without `source_object`, an empty `source_object`, a null `source_id`;
- DOM: the synthesized default page's `record:discussion` node (asserted to be the bare `{ type: 'record:discussion' }`) renders the call, meeting and email and not the finished task; the `record:activity` self-fetch renders the call and not the task.

### Ablation, from committed `f45e02a`, each restore proven

Driven by objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode (anchor must hit once, blob must change, restore proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`), inside a bash EXIT/INT/TERM trap with an absolute path. The tests import the module by relative path, so the runs read `src` and no `dist/` rebuild is involved. Directions predicted before running; observed matched.

1. Exemption removed. First attempt was a NO-OP and is void: the replacement text was a substring of the anchor, so the tool refused it (exit 1, replacement count 1 to 1) and no test ran. Retried with anchor `|| isLoggedInteraction(i));` to `|| false);`: 6 failed, 88 passed. The 6 are the two default-visibility pins, the `types: ['task']` pin, the `unifiedTimeline: false` pin and both DOM pins. Restored: blob `8b704626b0c1` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
2. Half pointer (`sourceObject` alone): 2 failed, 92 passed, the two `source_id`-missing CONTROLs. Restored the same way.
3. Every `task` exempt: 16 failed, 78 passed: 13 in the new file, plus the objectui#12106 unmarked-row CONTROL and its DOM pin, and the base file's "shows everything but completed activities by default". Restored the same way.

## Verification on final HEAD `62826ed`

Branch merged with `origin/main` at `923504f4` (merge `fdf2388`, no rebase).

- plugin-detail's dependency closure rebuilt after the merge: `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-detail^...' --concurrency=2`, 11 of 11 tasks.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` (echoed `type-check`, ran `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0 on HEAD. `--listFiles` on the test program lists the new file.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/` in 4 shards on `fdf2388`: 261 files passed and 1 skipped (262, the tracked count of test files in the package); 2530 tests passed, 14 skipped. The one commit after it (`62826ed`) changes only the new test file, and the three feed files were re-run on it: 3 files, 94 tests passed.
- Readers outside the package, on HEAD: `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` (console), `activityItemType-6730.test.ts` and the three `RecordDetailView` feed pins (`activityMapIdentity-5878`, `activityUnmappedType-5896`, `discussionFallbackPipeline-8983`): 5 files, 287 tests passed.
- Exit 0 on HEAD `62826ed`: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-presence`, `changeset:check`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-examples` (both after rebuilding their 35-package set on the merged tree), `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-json`, `docs:check-links`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:phantom-deps`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail lint` (`eslint .`): exit 0, 0 errors. Per touched file against its BASE blob (BASE linted through `--stdin` at the same path): `recordActivityFeed.ts` 0/0, `record-chatter.tsx` 12/12 warnings, `index.tsx` 32/32 warnings, the new test 0.

## Acceptance notes

- File surface: `packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx` is outside the claim's listed surface. Its `showCompleted` input description ("Off by default. A milestone row ... shows either way.") would read false for a logged interaction after this change, so one sentence is appended, as objectui#12106 did for milestones. `record-chatter.tsx` gets a comment-only correction of the same sentence.
- Release text: the pending `.changeset/12106-milestone-kind-reader.md` says a `completed` row an app inserts itself stays hidden by default. That other changeset is not edited; this PR's changeset says which sentence it narrows, so the combined release notes read in order.
- Boundary: a producer that writes a finished to-do AS a pointer to the to-do record would show by default too. No producer read for this card does that (the platform mirror writes no pointer; HotCRM's only `sys_activity` writers are the three interaction actions).
- No server change is needed: HotCRM already writes the pointer, so the rows a v17 runtime serves today are judged correctly. Hosted HotCRM gets this with cloud's framework move (objectstack-ai/cloud#2709, per triage).
- HotCRM's per-page `showCompleted: true` (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2079) still renders the same; whether to drop it there is HotCRM's call.
- NOT MEASURED: a live readback (`log_call` on `objectstack dev`, then the console page). Reason: no backend was run for this card; the served shape is read from the producer source and the platform object declaration above.
- `origin/main` moved after the merge (to `6fb281d6`: a types change to the dashboard widget envelope, a CI change, a console rename; none touch plugin-detail, these docs or the lockfile). Not merged again; the merge queue rebuilds on current `main`.
- The default-page DOM pin logs react-i18next's no-instance warning (the block mounts without an i18n provider); it is not an assertion.
